summary.text: Danica Hartenfels is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 189, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Tarah Probst (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner and mother with more than 20 years of experience in corporate America.

paragraphs.text: Danica Hartenfels earned a bachelor's degree from East Stroudsburg University, and her career experience includes working as a business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she volunteers with several local organizations and serves on several boards.

Hartenfels' campaign messages in the survey center on lowering costs for families, seniors and small businesses and expanding access to capital for small businesses, supporting police and first responders, investing in roads and infrastructure, protecting seniors and veterans from scams, and prioritizing early literacy, teacher support and career pathways in schools.
